q: 1. Section lining is drawn with line at .............
explain: As per standard hatching conventions, section lining (hatching) is typically drawn at 45° to the main outline/axis of the sectioned part.

q: 2. Which of the following curves obeys the Boyle's law?
explain: Boyle's Law (pressure × volume = constant, at constant temperature) describes an inverse relationship (PV=k), which graphically corresponds to a rectangular hyperbola.

q: 3. The representation of any matter by some sign or marks on the drawing is known as .............
explain: Standardized signs, symbols, or marks used to represent specific materials, features, or information on a drawing are collectively called conventions.
